summary: Selects additional Ouster lidar data images from an Ouster TOP, mapping sensor channels such as range, signal, reflectivity, near IR, flags, and XYZ into RGBA outputs.

common_gotchas: Documented as available in Educational, Commercial, and Pro licenses.
Outputs are 4-channel 32-bit float data images; downstream display or math should preserve float precision.
The primary Ouster TOP must be configured and cooking for selection to produce useful data.
Second-return fields only make sense with a matching Ouster data format.
Common TOP viewer filtering notes say 32-bit float data uses nearest filtering regardless of selection.
key_concepts: Creates additional output images from sensor data collected by an Ouster TOP.
Each output is a 4-channel 32-bit float RGBA data image.
Can select range, signal, reflectivity, near IR, flags, constants, and XYZ positions per channel.
Raw range is measured in millimeters while calculated XYZ positions are in meters.
